blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists can expect another wave of oil price rollbacks next week, amid projections of weaker global fuel demand. Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said diesel could drop by P2.35 to P2.55 per liter. READ: Gulf nations on alert after US strikes Iranian island Gasoline prices may likewise decrease by P2 to P2.15 per liter. “Oil fell this week, despite the fading prospect of an imminent reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and normalization of flows, on expectations of a supply surplus amid a weaker demand outlook,” he said.
